caseName: Zim Israel Navigation Co. v. Tarabocchia
caseNameFull: Zim Israel Navigation Co., Ltd. v. Tarabocchia

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Usner v. Luckenbach Overseas Corp., 400 U. S. 494, decided January 25, 1971.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Douglas, Mr. Justice Harlan, and Mr. Justice Brennan dissent.
